---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

An interactive look at completion times across thousands of video games from HowLongToBeat.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load data and group games by release decade
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(main_story_hours),
    !is.na(completionist_hours),
    !is.na(release_year),
    release_year >= 1980
  ) |>
  mutate(decade = paste0(10 * (release_year %/% 10), "s"))

# Scatter plot: Main story vs completionist hours
p <- games |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = main_story_hours,
    y = completionist_hours,
    color = decade,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", game_name, "</b> (", release_year, ")<br>",
      "Main Story: ", main_story_hours, " hrs<br>",
      "100% Completionist: ", completionist_hours, " hrs"
    )
  )) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#888888", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "1980s" = "#9b59b6",
    "1990s" = "#3498db",
    "2000s" = "#2ecc71",
    "2010s" = "#f39c12",
    "2020s" = "#e74c3c"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Main Story vs. 100% Completionist Hours by Decade",
    x = "Main Story (Hours)",
    y = "100% Completionist (Hours)",
    color = "Decade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA)
  )

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#222222",
    plot_bgcolor = "#222222",
    font = list(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend = list(font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
  )
```
